question: The value of 6{1 over 4} div [ {4{7 over 8} + {3 over 4} times ( {9{1 over 2} - 7{2 over 3}} )} ] is :
solution:
**Given:**

 6{1 over 4} ÷ [ {4{7 over 8} + {3 over 4} × ( {9{1 over 2} - 7{2 over 3}} )} ] 

**Concept:**

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf30f37945dd983713c79f4e75972597226df7b829d8603182b9eed448249aba.png] 

**Calculation:**

 6{1 over 4} ÷ [ {4{7 over 8} + {3 over 4} × ( {9{1 over 2} - 7{2 over 3}} )} ] 

⇒ 25over4 ÷ [{39over8}+{3over4}×({{19over2}-{23over3}})]

⇒ 25over4 ÷ [{39over8}+{3over4}×({{57-46}over6})] 

⇒ 25over4 ÷ [{39over8}+{3over4}×{11over6}]

⇒ 25over4 ÷ [{39over8}+{11over8}]

⇒ 25over4 ÷ 50over8 = 25over4 × 8over50 = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**
